trial_court: Court of Ld. Administrative Civil Judge cum Addl. Rent Controller (Central), Delhi
case_name: Smt. Veena Solanki vs Karuna Singh

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Veena Solanki, wife and Eti Solanki, daughter
parties.respondent_defendant: Karuna Singh, widow; Master Surya Pratap Singh, son; Master Sridev Singh, son; Commissioner of Customs (Import & General); Pay and Accounts officers

outcome_detected:
the order of
Ld Trial court is upheld
facts_of_case: Karuna Singh claimed herself to be the widow of Sh. S. P. S. Solanki, seeking succession certificate. Appellants filed a separate petition for grant of succession certificate in their favour. The trial court decided in favour of Karuna Singh.

legal_principles.principle: The court cannot rely on averments made in an application U/o 1 Rule 10 CPC for coming to a conclusion.
legal_principles.held: The findings based on this document is an irregularity committed by ld. Trial court.
cited_cases: Challamma V. Tilaga and Ors (2009) 9 Supreme Court Cases 299

legal_principles.principle: A marriage is presumed to be valid unless proven otherwise.
legal_principles.held: Section 114 of the Indian Evidence Act clearly raises presumption in favour of validity of a marriage.
cited_cases: Challamma V. Tilaga and Ors (2009) 9 Supreme Court Cases 299

outcome.final_order: The order of Ld Trial court is upheld
